name: DashCore
description: Android64 Bismuth-inspired GLES visibility-classifier prototype for Geometry Dash. Uses node-local content bounds transformed through the Cocos world-space hierarchy, protects all triggers, effects, and grouped objects, and reduces repeated scene scans. GPU visibility remains diagnostic only; live render culling is hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Reserved for future testing. DashCore 0.8.0 hard-disables live object hiding; all grouped objects, triggers, and effects remain protected.
